extDescription.message: Cast the current tab's stream to a DLNA or Google Cast device on your local network.

pickerPrompt.message: Choose where to cast the current tab

helperHint.message: Install the local helper, or start it and retry.

helperOutdated.message: A new helper version is available.

updateBusyMsg.message: Stop the cast first, then update the helper.

updateFailedMsg.message: The helper could not update itself. Click the notice again to get the new version from the project's page.

errDrm.message: This stream is DRM-protected, so it can't be cast.

errStreamUnavailable.message: Couldn't open this stream. It may be offline, region-locked, or unsupported.

errStreamExpired.message: The stream expired. Reload the page and cast again.

needTokenHint.message: Paste the helper's token in the options.

optionsHelp.message: Paste the helper's token. You'll find it in the file ~/.streaming-lan-cast/token in your home folder (the helper also prints it on startup).

noSourceFound.message: No video source detected. Play the video and try again.

errBlobSource.message: This page's video has no address that can be cast.

enableDetectHint.message: Enable source detection, then reload the page and try again.

detectEnabledReload.message: Detection enabled. Reload the page (or start the video), then cast.

optCastHelp.message: Phones on your network can show a card with controls for a cast running on a TV. These settings decide what that card shows and whether it can act on the cast. A cast to a DLNA device shows no card.

optCastMeta.message: Show the stream's title and image on those controls

optCastOthers.message: Let other devices on the network control the cast (play, pause, seek, stop)

optCastAwake.message: Keep this computer awake while casting

autoDownMsg.message: Lowered to $1: the TV takes $2 Mb/s and $3 needs $4.
autoDownMsg.description: $1 new quality, $2 measured Mb/s, $3 previous quality, $4 Mb/s it needs

autoNoLowerMsg.message: The TV takes $1 Mb/s and $2 needs $3; there is no lower quality to switch to.
autoNoLowerMsg.description: $1 measured Mb/s, $2 quality, $3 Mb/s it needs

autoBackBtn.description: $1 the quality the helper stepped down from

optUpdAskHelp.message: It installs only versions signed by the project, never during a cast. You can change this later under Helper updates.

optAutoUpdateHelp.message: Signed versions only, never during a cast.

optAutoUpdOffEnv.message: Turned off on this computer by SLC_AUTO_UPDATE=0, whatever this box says.

optAutoUpdOffSource.message: This helper runs from a copy of the source code, so it updates through git rather than by itself.

optAutoUpdOffReadonly.message: The helper cannot write to the folder it is installed in, so it cannot update itself. Run the installer again to update it.

optAutoUpdOffPlatform.message: This helper build does not update itself. Run the installer again to update it.
